name: qa-slab-electrostatics-008
description: You have a slab geometry with vacuum along the z-direction and long-range Coulombic interactions. In LAMMPS, long-range electrostatics are often computed using the PPPM (Particle-Particle Particle-Mesh) method, which combines real-space and reciprocal-space calculations. What is the best practice to avoid artificial interactions across the vacuum?
